verdict: M166r2 is a center-correct, exact-SHA standalone rank3-left plus binary-ATLIF decision backend. Its 241-tile VCS scoreboard and seven directed covers support a five-cycle local recurrence with backpressure safety; fresh source/report/netlist parsing confirms 96 mapped signed 8x8 multiplication operations, 9338 explicit data/metadata register bits plus 23 control flops, and the sealed 3 ns logic-only DC result. The 1.666667x product ratio and 1.7x capacity-cycle boundary are conditional arithmetic limits, not measured FFN or network speedup. M167 should integrate FRONT/BACK/PREFOLD modes over one 96-slot pool, but cannot admit an FFN claim until INT8 Lprime, reciprocal-square-root, rank-epoch replay, ATLIF threshold amplitude and fc2 numeric order are closed.

r1_to_r2_center_identity.identity_result: The r1 and r2 source identities differ; current source, canonical r2 VCS and sealed DC all bind r2 SHA. The change repairs the documented generic folded-bias identity. Because RTL already consumed externally prepared folded_bias verbatim, r1 functional observations remain informative but r1 is not the canonical algebra identity.

canonical_r2_vcs.scope: The scoreboard proves synthetic Q8 folded-coefficient backend behavior and local elasticity. It does not test checkpoint coefficients, coefficient generation, epoch addresses, fc2, or full FFN order.

source_and_mapped_resources.important_contract_precision: The precontract's input_rank_fifo_bits=768 and output_event_fifo_bits=512 count payload only. Including tag/last/beat metadata, the FIFOs are 802 and 832 bits respectively.

logic_only_dc.qualification: Same-flow standalone logic-only synthesis at one requested 3 ns point. It is not placed/routed PPA, extracted timing, Fmax, power or energy. Rounded zero hold margin must not be presented as physical margin.

prefold_algebra_and_conditional_capacity.admission_boundary: All ratios are conditional capacity boundaries. Dense 17 cycles is a lower bound, while rank3 10 cycles excludes coefficient generation, rsqrt, moment barrier, rank-state write/replay, fill/drain, fc2 and memory effects. Neither 1.666667x nor 1.7x is a measured operator, FFN, network or system speedup.

m165_m166_composition.reason: The two standalone netlists duplicate product resources, FIFOs, register-backed configuration and interface/control logic; they were not composed or resynthesized as one shared resource. A numeric sum would at most describe an unimplemented duplicate-pool upper-bound instantiation, not the proposed reused accelerator.
m165_m166_composition.m167_decision: GO: build FRONT/BACK/PREFOLD modes around one physical 96-slot signed product pool. FRONT and BACK are separated by the mandatory channel-moment barrier, and PREFOLD occupies only the post-moment/pre-replay window, so temporal sharing is architecturally natural.
m167_required_contract: one mutually exclusive mode owner and accepted-operation accounting for all 96 slots
FRONT preserves M165 five-beat right projection; the separate 32-square moment sidecar is costed explicitly
PREFOLD format is not assumed 8x8 until alpha/offset ranges are frozen; widened slots or lane serialization must be resynthesized
BACK preserves M166 five-cycle left/ATLIF recurrence
one address-bearing rank epoch, coefficient epoch and barrier protocol prevents cross-channel replay
matched three-mode versus duplicate-pool DC and complete dense versus rank3 cycle simulation

atlif_output_amplitude_gate.software_semantics: Official binary ATLIF emits {0,+threshold}; it is not an unscaled {0,1} tensor.
atlif_output_amplitude_gate.m166_interface: event_bits carries only the comparator decision. No threshold amplitude or quantized activation value is transported with each event.
required_resolution: restore the nonzero threshold amplitude before fc2, or
fold threshold times the activation binary point into fc2 weights/scales and prove bias, accumulation width, RNE, saturation and output commit order against the checkpoint

findings.title: Dynamic Lprime has no checkpoint-bound INT8 range or factor-rebalance proof
findings.evidence: M166 hardwires 96 signed 8x8 products, but alpha is data-dependent and Lprime=alpha*L. Synthetic signed-INT8 coefficients do not establish that all twelve H67 FFN instances fit or preserve rounding.
findings.required_fix: Freeze PAFT L/R and per-layer scales, rebalance factors, prove every Lprime range and exact requant order, then rerun valid825. If any coefficient widens, resynthesize and recalculate the shared-pool capacity.

findings.title: Binary event bits drop ATLIF threshold amplitude before fc2
findings.evidence: The software OfficialATLIFSurrogate returns active*threshold, while M166 exports only event_bits and explicitly omits fc2. A raw bit is not the checkpoint activation value.
findings.required_fix: Either materialize {0,threshold} at fc2 input or prove threshold/activation-scale folding into fc2 weights and scales with identical bias, accumulation width, RNE, saturation and commit order.

findings.title: Reciprocal-square-root and dynamic coefficient generation are absent
findings.evidence: M166 starts from externally supplied folded_left Q8 and folded_bias Q24. Population variance, epsilon, rsqrt, alpha, offset, LR1 and coefficient completion latency/area are outside the module.
findings.required_fix: Implement or accurately model the moment-to-alpha/offset/coefficients path, freeze formats and rounding, and include its post-barrier latency and storage in the operator schedule.

findings.title: No address-bearing rank epoch or complete fair FFN cycle comparison exists
findings.evidence: M165 and M166 are separate standalone streams. There is no spatial address, channel epoch, barrier authentication, rank-state SRAM, fc2/BN2/residual commit or complete same-resource dense baseline.
findings.required_fix: Use M167 to close one shared-pool epoch schedule and run complete dense versus rank3 FFN cycle simulation including moment, prefold, replay, fc2 and drains.

findings.title: M165 and M166 standalone DC areas cannot be summed as shared-pool PPA
findings.evidence: Each netlist owns an independent 96-product pool and its own FIFO/configuration/control fabric. No composed netlist proves resource sharing or interface elimination.
findings.required_fix: Synthesize M167 as one FRONT/BACK/PREFOLD implementation and compare it against a deliberately defined duplicate-pool reference.

findings.title: The 1.7x result is a capacity boundary, not measured speedup
findings.evidence: 17 cycles is ceil(1600/96), while 10 cycles is two ceil(480/96) passes. Only the rank3 backend recurrence has RTL/VCS timing; coefficient, barrier, memory and remaining FFN costs are omitted.
findings.required_fix: Publish 1.666667x product reduction and 1.7x ideal capacity boundary only as analytical limits until a full address-timed cycle simulator supplies measured operator latency.

findings.title: Register-backed coefficient ports dominate the standalone sequential population
findings.evidence: 7704 of 9361 mapped flops store folded_left, folded_bias and threshold. There is no coefficient SRAM macro, access schedule or energy.
findings.required_fix: In M167, define coefficient bank ports and lifetime, then replace the register envelope with an admitted macro or CACTI-backed memory cost before PPA/energy claims.

findings.title: No mapped RTL-to-gate equivalence receipt exists
findings.evidence: Exact-SHA VCS and DC are sealed, but the mapped netlist has no Formality closure.
findings.required_fix: Run Formality on the final M167 identity; retain synthesis-only wording for M166 meanwhile.

findings.title: The 3 ns result is pre-macro, ideal-clock and ZeroWireload with rounded zero hold margin
findings.evidence: DC reports setup +0.4672 ns and hold +0.0000 ns with zero macros and no extracted parasitics.
findings.required_fix: Keep the exact logic-only qualifier and perform macro-aware STA/SAIF/PTPX on the final shared-pool block before physical PPA or energy statements.

findings.title: PAFT and valid825 remain unbound to M166
findings.evidence: The directed VCS uses synthetic coefficients and explicitly records paft_valid825=false.
findings.required_fix: Bind the recovered factor checkpoint and numeric manifest, then run the declared valid825 accuracy gate with the exact hardware-order path.

findings.title: FIFO payload labels omit metadata
findings.evidence: The DC precontract says input_rank_fifo_bits=768 and output_event_fifo_bits=512, but mapped/source totals including tag/last/beat are 802 and 832 bits.
findings.required_fix: Use payload_bits and total_data_metadata_bits as separate fields in M167 contracts.

findings.title: Directed VCS uses one seed and does not exercise numeric rail proofs
findings.evidence: The scoreboard is strong for protocol/order but coefficients are small synthetic values; no worst-case Q24 bias/add overflow, threshold rails or alternate seed campaign is bound.
findings.required_fix: After formats freeze, add worst-case accumulator/threshold vectors and a deterministic multi-seed or formal arithmetic miter.

findings.title: Output FIFO reserves five beats but has no external address identity
findings.evidence: Tag/channel_last/beat ordering is covered, yet tag is opaque and cannot authenticate stage, hidden group, spatial tile or coefficient epoch.
findings.required_fix: M167 should carry explicit epoch and tile address fields through rank storage and event commit assertions.

allowed_claims: M166r2 corrects the prefold identity to include -center and its canonical VCS/DC source SHA is 9afaf28c92f344c8a1cc0126226579b842420bda4d48f8ddcc26458c86f2d646.
A 241-tile exact-SHA VCS scoreboard passes 1205 output beats and all seven directed covers, including output stalls and same-cycle input push/release.
The standalone backend sustains a five-cycle no-backpressure recurrence and a fresh exhaustive count/phase model finds no unsafe transition across 172 reachable states.
The source and postcompile resource report contain 96 signed 8x8 multiplication operations; mapped named storage is 9338 DFFs plus 23 control DFFs.
The matched logic-only DC result is 44280.053123 um2, 35675 cells, 9361 sequential cells, 47 logic levels, setup +0.4672 ns and hold +0.0000 ns at a requested 3 ns ideal-clock ZeroWireload point.

Real-domain prefolding requires 640 coefficient products per 16-lane group, or seven 96-slot product cycles; the dense/rank3 product ratio is conditionally 1.666667x and the ideal capacity boundary is 17 versus 10 cycles.

M166's event bit is numerically equivalent to the ATLIF {0,threshold} output at fc2
all dynamic folded-left coefficients fit signed INT8
M165 plus M166 standalone areas equal the area of a shared-pool accelerator
1.666667x or 1.7x is measured FFN, network or system speedup
the five-cycle backend is the end-to-end FFN II
the DC result is placed/routed PPA, Fmax, power or energy
PAFT, valid825, rsqrt, rank-epoch replay, fc2 or full FFN equivalence has passed
